headline: Sunday, November 8 — new moon, gentle reset

sections.lead: Sun beats the forecast today, then clouds settle in.
items: Today (Sun): the hourly feed reads mostly sunny even though the day forecast says cloudy, so call it sun breaking through: high near 70, low 51, 0% rain, light wind 2-5 mph. Sunrise 6:40, sunset 5:00.
Hour by hour: 5am 53, 8am 56, 10am 60, noon 67, 2pm 70, 3pm 70 (peak), 4pm 70, 5pm 67, 8pm 60, 10pm 59, evening clouds building.
The rest of the grid: Mon cloudy 72/51. Tue sunny 71/50. Wed sunny 67/50. Thu partly sunny 64/50. Fri mostly sunny 66/53.
Rain arrives next weekend: light rain Sat Nov 14 (55% that night) and Sun Nov 15 (59/49, gusty to 21 mph).

sections.lead: The new moon lands this afternoon, in your identity corner.
items: Plain English: today's new moon is the monthly reset point, the moment astrologers use for planting intentions, and it happens in Scorpio, the sign of going deep rather than wide. Its one wrinkle: it sits square your natal Sun, so you may feel a tug between the drive to do and the body's request to rest.

How to use it: write one intention for the next four weeks around the job search, something like 'the right role finds me through a warm conversation', then actually rest. Monday's routine restarts the momentum.

Specifics: New Moon Scorpio 9.6 square natal Sun 0.5; Venus (R) Libra 26.1 conj natal Moon 0.9; Pluto sextile natal Moon 0.9; Mercury (R) Scorpio 7.6 square natal Sun 1.6; Sun opp natal Asc 2.2; Saturn (R) Aries 11.8 trine natal Sun 2.7.

sections.lead: Still nothing new; five leads wait on you.
items: Zero new postings passed the filters overnight. The three fresh raw candidates today (two Waymo technical-lead roles and a junior Figma people-ops job) didn't clear them.
Still waiting on your review on the Job Hunt tab: Harvey EA, Flexport Business Operations Manager (Office of the CEO), the two Figma EAs, and Stripe's Administrative Business Partner.
Boards note: Uber Freight and Serve's feeds wouldn't load again; Lightspeed and NFX stay queued for the 3pm sweep.

sections.lead: A courtroom verdict and a Saturday shooting in town.
items: A 40-year-old Antioch man was convicted Nov 4 in the DUI hit-and-run death of bicyclist Linda Alize Wooldridge on Lone Tree Way in 2024; he faces up to 15 years.
An independent review cleared a Contra Costa DA inspector in last year's fatal crash that killed Phoenix Dunn on Highway 4.
A man was shot in the foot on Manzanita Way at 8:20pm Friday and is recovering; Antioch police are investigating (tips: 925-779-6926).

sections.lead: Quiet: no new application mail in two days.
items: Nothing new since Thursday: the Mintive and Kenco declines stand, and no interview requests have arrived.
Flexport and Rothy's remain quiet confirmations.

items: Easy win: say the word and I'll draft the Granite thank-yous, with your paving-vs-dirt mix question folded in for Brian.

Nothing on Tony's calendar through Monday.

sections.lead: Gray Monday, then two bright days before the rain.
items: Monday is cloudy but mild at 72/51; Tuesday and Wednesday turn sunny before next weekend's first rain.
